create_embedding_index: create an embedding-based index that stores documents and retrieves them by semantic similarity
build_rewriting_index: build a rewriting index that chunks documents before storing them in an inner embedding index
test_naive_index: test the naive index that returns the first K added documents regardless of the query
refactor_discrete_field_key: refactor the embedding-based index to rename or merge keys in its discrete field reverse index
summarize_index_state: summarize the index state by saving and loading embedding-based document index to disk
